cue.property: Every selected matrix has exactly one cell for every declared row-column coordinate.
A selected matrix cannot encode the same row-column coordinate twice.
Matrix coordinates are concrete members of the declared axes; wildcard coordinates are not contract values.
Every matrix cell references only a row and column declared by that matrix.
Each matrix axis is a duplicate-free closed set.
An operation exposes exactly the request-error set selected by the contract.
Every closed variant retains its explicitly selected wire identity.
WaitOperation remains observational and cannot be reclassified as a mutating call.

cue.mutation: observation changed to an accepted branch
cue.property: An observation exposes exactly its selected result branches and cannot acquire a mutation-acceptance branch.
A transition target resolves within the selected matrix state universe.

cue.mutation: matrix cell has a valid but source-incorrect kind
cue.property: A cell retains the exact kind selected for its row-column coordinate.

cue.mutation: transition has a valid but source-incorrect next state
cue.property: A transition retains its exact selected target, even when another target is structurally valid.

cue.mutation: reject has a valid but source-incorrect request error
cue.property: A rejection cell retains its exact selected error, even when another error is admissible for that operation.
Every operation matrix reference resolves to its exact selected matrix set.
The executable oracle accepts only the selected bundle format version.
The executable oracle is bound to the selected contract identity.
The contract model is closed and rejects undeclared fields.

cue.mutation: regenerated schema from an incomplete matrix
cue.property: Matrix totality is an oracle relation over concrete data, not a fact copied from the generator input.

cue.mutation: regenerated schema from duplicate matrix coordinates
cue.property: Coordinate uniqueness remains enforced even when the schema is regenerated from the same invalid model.

cue.mutation: regenerated schema from an extra undeclared matrix cell
cue.property: Declared-coordinate membership remains enforced even when the schema is regenerated from the same invalid model.

quint.property: A rejected request creates neither a durable handle nor a dispatch.
Dispatch requires intent that was already durable before the dispatch transition.
An equal replay returns the original durable handle.
A conflicting replay cannot dispatch or mutate resource/effect state.
An actor from a stale runtime epoch cannot retain current authority.
Success requires evidence of the exact requested postcondition.
Failure or cancellation cannot be committed while an authority may still act.
A terminal unknown Operation cannot dispatch a blind successor.
A terminal Operation result is immutable.
A wait timeout observes state without mutating the resource.
Provider acknowledgement alone is insufficient evidence of success.
